task: CC task REWARD-01 - aircraft-loss coefficient development comparison R1 (2026-09-26)

authorization.source: user-selected first intervention and bounded task, transferred to CC via the GPT orchestrator packet CC_REWARD_01_Coefficient_Dev_R1_FINAL (2026-09-26)
authorization.task_specific_review_exception: The packet authorizes one end-to-end sequence (configs, pre-launch checks, two training arms, evidence, documentation) with GPT exact-candidate review only at completion. This waives the intermediate review stop for THIS task only; implementation and measurements stay UNREVIEWED until the final review.
authorization.supersedes: the handoff's discussion-only / no-experiment status for REWARD-01 ONLY; no other section 5.1 question is authorized
not_authorized: a third arm or any other coefficient
checkpoint loading, conversion, transfer or warm start
production code, test, reward-formula, reference, physics, solver, sampler, benchmark or default change

scientific_question: Does doubling aircraft_penalty_coeff from 2.25 to 4.5, with the current actor observation and every other learning / environment choice fixed, improve acquisition and retention of conditional MILD / SEVERE behaviour and the observed mission / survival trade-off?
design_class: one-factor, one-seed-pair DEVELOPMENT sensitivity experiment with a contemporaneous control on the SAME measured commit

factor.name: aircraft_penalty_coeff (TrainConfig -> RewardConfig via TrainConfig.reward_config)
factor.rationale: a deliberately simple doubling; not an estimated optimum, not a measured aircraft value and not a diagnosed bug fix
factor.what_it_changes: the relative loss cost c*p in R(c) = q - c*p; not causal credit and not the actor's information
factor.reward_identity: R(c) = q - c*p, q = (U_prefix + U_post - U_ref)/D, p = U_aircraft*n_lost/D, D = |U_ref| + 1e-5 (graph_reward._event_conditioned_breakdown; formula unchanged)
non_claims: a larger raw penalty need not imply a proportional normalized advantage or optimizer step
this is not a uniform rescaling of all rewards
it may induce ABORT in both severities

arms.order: A then B, sequentially, one training process at a time; B runs regardless of A's scientific behaviour provided A completes without a validity blocker

population_and_configuration.configuration_source: each arm preset = the section-17 run_config.json train_config (research_evidence/generalized_v2/actor_mission_slack_dev_r1/run_artifacts/run_config.json) minus output_dir, plus actor_step_diagnostics=false and actor_step_vector_iterations=[] (fields added after that record), with aircraft_penalty_coeff set per arm; resolved through the trainer's own --config path (config_source.resolved_from = config_file); output_dir from --out
population_and_configuration.actor_observation_id: actor_graph_task6_agent2_fuel_norm_mission_fuel_slack_v1 (graph_builder.ACTOR_OBSERVATION_ID; not a TrainConfig field; verified from the resolved run_config training block)
population_and_configuration.evaluation: existing deterministic semantic selection on the frozen DEVELOPMENT profile: 20 matched triads x CLEAN/MILD/SEVERE = 60 members per round; 960 scheduled evaluation episodes per arm, 1920 in total; legacy eval_episodes=8 does not redefine the profile
population_and_configuration.initialization: fresh process, fresh optimizer, from-scratch seeded initialization per arm; no checkpoint warm start, conversion, resume or transfer

benchmark.reuse_only: no regeneration, substitute worlds, reselection, additional seeds or confirmatory profile
benchmark.held_out_check: every manifest seed outside [3000000, 3004500) via manifest_seed_overlap, before launch; the trainer repeats it at start-up

execution.context: LOCAL Windows, conda nlp_env, CPU, the same environment for both arms; no cluster / GPU switch, no dependency install or upgrade
execution.source: ONE clean detached worktree C:\grc1src of MEASURED_CODE_SHA for both arms; imports verified to resolve to it; the imported frozen BLADE engine verified Git-blob-identical to the measured tree
execution.measured_code_sha: the full SHA of the pushed branch commit that contains this plan, the presets and the scripts; frozen before launch and recorded in prelaunch/preflight.json, never inside the commit it identifies
execution.launcher: scripts/launch_with_watchdog.py: one process, console captured, launcher_record.json kept current, exit code written by Python, 4-hour hard cap per arm (kills the process tree), pre-update identity monitor for arm B

env.other: inherited unchanged and identical for both arms; thread settings recorded, not altered

execution.output_rule: fresh directories under C:\gruns\ that must not exist; never overwrite; originals, worktree, checkpoints and run directories preserved

primary_endpoint.statistic: per arm: final-round ten-base-cell macro average of paired P(ABORT | SEVERE) - P(ABORT | MILD) at the certified ego's immediate-FD wake; plus B minus A
primary_endpoint.round: final round selected semantically: evaluation_stage post_update at updates_completed = 375
primary_endpoint.eligibility: metric eligibility reported per cell and group; missing is never zero; no macro with an empty cell. If eligibility differs between arms, both populations are disclosed and a common-group descriptive contrast is given separately and is NOT called the primary endpoint

required_trajectory_and_secondary: all 16 rounds per arm: MILD and SEVERE P(ABORT) separately, macro gap, directional switches (MILD non-ABORT / SEVERE ABORT), reverse switches, both-ABORT and both-non-ABORT counts

per arm / round / member cell: raw scored utility (U_prefix + U_post), unique, scored and unscored confirmations, deaths and survivors, end reason, immediate-FD RTB issuance kept separate from survival, with denominators

per frozen world (round, group, member cell): arm-A versus arm-B outcome contrasts, with each arm's own reference terms (U_ref, U_prefix, U_cont_ref, U_aircraft, reference kind / tick); references are not assumed identical across policies

algebraic rescoring of BOTH arms' saved evaluation outcomes at c = 2.25 and c = 4.5 via R(c) = q - c*p from each trajectory's recorded reference; policies compared under each COMMON coefficient; no replay, no counterfactual outcome; native rewards at different c are never compared as one scale

standard training transition counts by update and wake kind; FD-selected-ego immediate-FD credit rows by severity with raw and normalized advantages kept separate; chosen-action group means are not local action values
acquisition (exploratory peaks / first rounds with switches) reported separately from retention (final round)
pre-update identity between arms: frozen-world inputs, wake sequences, selected actions and probabilities compared; reward differences at pre-update are expected whenever losses occur
stop_conditions: integrity exception (roster / measurement / quota / benchmark / reference / solver / fuel-damage / observation / artifact)

pre_update_mismatch_rule.applies_to: arm B, against arm A's already recorded pre_update round; compares recorded outputs only (no extra evaluation, replay or checkpoint loading)
stop_if: any frozen-world identity field differs for a member (seed, episode_tag, benchmark_group_key, member_cell, benchmark_world_identity, benchmark_manifest_id, benchmark_stratum, benchmark_world_ordinal, fuel_damage_mode)
the set of pre_update members differs
any member's wake sequence differs in count, wake kind, ego, tick, selected meta-action or selected leaf
any recorded semantic meta-action probability differs by more than 1e-6 absolute
pre_update_mismatch_rule.tolerance_rationale: same seed and source do not guarantee bit-identical trajectories (measurements section 18 recorded a 7.45e-9 training-output difference); 1e-6 is two orders above that and far below any behavioural difference
pre_update_mismatch_rule.record_only: episode outcomes (U, deaths, ticks, end reason, FD fields) and the exact 2x penalty relation are recorded descriptively, not as stop conditions
pre_update_mismatch_rule.on_detection: the launcher kills arm B's process tree and records pre_update_mismatch_stop; no repair or relaunch

expected_attrition: accounted no_fd_eligible_ego setup failures, replaced only by the existing monotone next-seed rule within 12 attempts per update; equality to the eight historical failed seeds is not assumed; any other failure category stops for review
on_stop: preserve incomplete evidence and return the exact cause; no repair-and-restart, replacement arm or budget extension
no_behaviour_dependent_stop: disappointing, saturated or favourable learning curves never stop the task
interpretation_limits: one training seed pair: no across-seed robustness estimate
a larger gap alone does not prove task benefit
ABORT in both severities does not establish the desired conditional response
a null result rejects neither all c values nor all reward redesigns
repeated development evaluation of the same 20 frozen worlds is not confirmatory
decision_informed: whether this ONE coefficient increase is promising enough for a later authorized robustness / calibration step, or whether CREDIT-01 / BASELINE-01 should come next; no other coefficient, model change or follow-up run in this task
evidence: research_evidence/generalized_v2/reward_coefficient_dev_r1/ in the SAME PR; large originals outside Git identified by SHA-256
